lesson.instruction: Give a 45–60 second spoken brief with three facts.
Ask two factual comprehension questions, one at a time.
Ask why the story matters and what impact it could have.
Ask for an opinion, evidence, and a response to one counterargument.
Request a 60–90 second summary separating fact and opinion.
Correct one or two high-impact issues and retain three expressions.

recommendedFrequency: twice per week, about 20–25% of sessions
